caustic_revision.lighting: Brighter neutral hemisphere, window and broad collection/bench fill; runtime baked-irradiance gain 2.1, exposure 1.05, neutral ivory default mat. Existing absorption/color presets unchanged. Focused aperture radius .06; broad aperture 1.25. Both direct modes use a shadowed source-center point proxy, filtered more broadly in broad mode, avoiding the former shadowless-rectangle double count.
caustic_revision.model: GPU light-side particle tracing through the selected actual convex gem. Shared Fresnel/facet exits with the eye tracer; Snell/TIR, stochastic Fresnel choices, Beer absorption, 3 correlated RGB wavelength channels, max 12 internal bounces. Projected-disk flux includes solid-angle Jacobian. Normalized 3-pixel Epanechnikov splats accumulate into a 512-square half-float irradiance map. No painted rainbow texture or artistic caustic amplitude multiplier.
caustic_revision.quality: 8192 photons/channel during motion (24576 paths); 16384/channel (49152 paths) after 180 ms stillness. Fully cached after refinement; opaque tiger eye skips the pass. Optional Refracted light on the bench toggle.

performance.device: Heather’s Apple M1 Max; Codex in-app browser, WebGL2 EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2
performance.scope: Caustic pass only; excludes initial shader compilation/buffer warmup and the main gem/scene draw. No total FPS or mobile-device guarantee. Earlier startup measurements were higher; warmed samples are explicitly labeled.

checks.projected_flux: Numerically integrated production disk samples agree with independent exact cone solid angle within 1e-6 relative tolerance, separately per RGB channel.
checks.sampling: Shared correlated RGB incident samples, deterministic frames and balanced 8x8 strata.
checks.webgl: Main diamond/emerald/sapphire shaders and photon pass compiled; no console warnings/errors. Settled draw changes path count to 49152 and stays cached. Focused grazing light adds bench irradiance; optional switch removes it.

limitations: Flat y=-1.32 receiver approximates mat/table heights; only horizontal bench surfaces in a narrow height band receive it.
Only the main faceted gem and selected examination source contribute; case samples, tiger eye and fill-light caustics are excluded.
No ring/prop occlusion along bent photon paths, full scene transport, measured spectral dispersion, fluorescence or unbiased spectral rendering.
Broad-source direct visibility uses filtered point-source shadow maps, not full area-source integration.
Finite photons and fixed kernel can soften/speckle the caustic; refinement reduces but does not eliminate sampling error.
Brilliant cuts return much light upward; their bench caustic need not fill the whole geometric shadow.
